record: EXPLORER-PRIVACY-001: what a My Space preview leaves behind
verified: memory ISOLATION: the preview module's linear memory, the worker's lifetime, and the page's live objects
not_verified: physical RAM erasure, swap, OS page reuse, and what the JavaScript engine does with memory it has already released; a browser cannot observe these

changes.module: bx_free zeroes the request (the object's bytes) with volatile stores before freeing it; new export bx_wipe zeroes the verdict arena after the host copies the verdict; the kernel allocates the text excerpt at its full 64 KB budget so no outgrown buffer is freed holding plaintext, and zeroes it before dropping it
changes.worker: calls bx_wipe immediately after copying each verdict
changes.page: closing a look terminates its worker, releasing the module memory and the worker's JavaScript copies; the next look starts a new worker from the same pinned module
changes.unchanged: the module still has no imports; the TEMP rail file keeps its this-visit lifetime (closing a preview does not delete the file the visitor chose to keep)
changes.residual_named: a few bytes of hash state or parser locals on the module stack are not zeroed; the worker's termination on close releases them

results_this_branch.10a_residue: canary text (~190 KB, 4,096 copies) previewed through the module ABI in Node: 0 copies left in module memory after the call; control: 4,096 seen while in memory
results_this_branch.10a_finding_during_work: the first fix left 181 copies: a growing String freed outgrown buffers; fixed by preallocating the excerpt
